paper_title: NASDUCK: New Constraints on Axion-like Dark Matter from Floquet Quantum Detector
notes: Main result is ALP-neutron coupling g_aNN in GeV^-1 (Eq. 2) using 129Xe spin detector, mass range 4e-15 to 4e-12 eV. rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3, epsilon_N=0.63. Data points are approximate reads from Fig. 2 exclusion band; precise tabulated bounds are in the linked repository (ref 48). Note g_aNN here has GeV^-1 units per the paper's convention (not dimensionless); values are rough order-of-magnitude estimates from the figure axis. Confidence lowered due to approximate figure reads. Proton bounds also cast but are model-dependent (secondary). | selector: text (sole candidate)
